description: This file is a shell script used for testing and facilitating Git commit behaviors. It includes functions for verifying commit messages, testing various commit scenarios, handling trailers, cleanup modes, and editor behaviors during Git operations.

methods.name: commit_msg_is
methods.description: Checks if the latest git log message matches the expected message.

methods.name: check_summary_oneline
methods.description: Verifies the output of a git commit summary format for a given message.

methods.name: trailer_commit_base
methods.description: Creates a commit with trailers appended to the message.

methods.name: output_tests_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment by checking out main and removing test files.

methods.name: try_commit
methods.description: Performs a git commit with optional arguments and verifies the presence of a template in the commit message.

methods.name: try_commit_status_combo
methods.description: Runs a series of tests related to commit --status and --no-status options, and their behavior with configuration.
